{{Quote|Go with the superior officer, or the will of the Senate. Command Code sorts it all out. No questions, no doubts, no hesitations.|[[Faie/Legends|Faie]]|<ref name="Hidden Enemy">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Command Code''', pursuant to the [[Kamino Accords]], was the set of guidelines that governed a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] behavior and every action.
